versions.name: Cooking
versions.description: Plan balanced menus, shop to them, and cook three days of meals at home, then feed your patrol in camp over a stove or fire and pack lightweight food for the trail. Clean up properly every time.

provenance.notes: Introduction year (and BSA number where absent) backfilled from the USSSP merit badge history table; for a renamed badge this is when THIS name took effect, not when the lineage began.
